temporal.split: rolling chronological origins; last third of eligible independent local target dates is outer assessment
temporal.inner_selection: earlier training dates only; final third never used to tune
temporal.window_limits: Support minima are per declared target; outcomes unavailable before decision are excluded, even if later discovered
temporal.fitting: one candidate family per named target; fixed regularization grids selected on inner dates only

weights: equal independent local target dates, then equal measured targets, then equal original issued forecasts; unique target identity includes observation policy and source cohort

selection.uncertainty: paired resampling by independent local-day blocks; forecast rows for the same observation stay together
selection.rain_support: Wet threshold and ambiguity band bind the actual gauge policy; at least six identifiable wet and six dry training targets across at least three wet events before fitting; all-dry data cannot select the two-part model

limits.production_limits: unchanged; jobs run through existing shared admission

source_rules: Historical collection acquired later cannot count as operational as-issued evidence
Matched challenger support and fallback-inclusive policy are both reported
Probability claims remain false without separate joint/downstream evidence
Station grid output is not site-specific inference; physical proxy scopes stay distinct
